rows.text: Provides Fiscal 2027 Guidance Delivered double-digit adjusted EPS growth in fiscal 2026 | Improved core business performance Reduced capital spend relative to prior year | Expanded backlog, including over $2.0 billion of new electronics wins
• Fiscal 2027 full-year adjusted EPS guidance * of $14.15 to $14.50; fiscal 2027 first quarter adjusted EPS guidance * of $3.35 to $3.45
Air Products expects full-year fiscal 2027 adjusted EPS guidance * in the range of $14.15 to $14.50.
For the fiscal 2027 first quarter, Air Products' adjusted EPS guidance * is $3.35 to $3.45.
